subject.title: feat(models): add provider request.timeoutMs and retry configuration

question: Should this PR expose provider-level retry config now, split retry out and review only `request.timeoutMs`, or wait for the canonical LLM retry/backoff design?
rationale: The retry half adds public config surface and changes fallback expectations, which requires maintainer API/product direction before merge; automation can repair mechanics but cannot choose the permanent retry contract.

options.title: Split Retry Out
options.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions from this PR and keep retry design on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49376 while reviewing a focused timeoutMs patch.

options.title: Implement Retry Fully
options.body: Wire provider retry into model calls with retryable error classification, fallback ordering, docs/baseline updates, upgrade behavior, and focused runtime tests before exposing the field.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Design
options.body: Pause or close this PR until maintainers settle the public retry/backoff contract on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49376.

recommendation.title: Split Retry Out
recommendation.body: Remove the retry schema/help/label/type additions from this PR and keep retry design on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49376 while reviewing a focused timeoutMs patch.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-main routing owner for provider schema, transport, and the retry/failover product surface touched here.
